From: Amir Khan <amir@brightbridge.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Overnight throughput top-up request for POC (Nov 21-22)

Hey David,

Quick one — we’re ramping the BrightBridge search-ranking POC next weekend (Nov 21–22) and expect a 6–8x spike in QPS during the late-night soak window (23:00–03:00 PST). Our engineering lead asked if Redwood can temporarily increase our free trial credits / sandbox allowance to cover the night so we can validate p95 under load.

High-level numbers:~
- Target window: 2026-11-21 23:00 to 2026-11-22 03:00 PST
- Expected peak: ~5k qps sustained for 15 min bursts, avg ~800 qps
- Estimated token usage: ~1.1M tokens per night (generation + embeddings)

We don’t yet have a PO but this is critical to show performance before procurement. Would you be able to provision a one-off top-up or a short trial extension? We can provide a short mutual action plan & security attestation if needed.

I’ve attached the traffic profile (brightbridge_poc_matrix.csv) for context.

Thanks — appreciate any runway you can provide.

— Amir
Amir Khan
Director, Engineering — BrightBridge
amir@brightbridge.com

Attachment: brightbridge_poc_matrix.csv (CSV, 14KB)

Subject: Re: Overnight throughput top-up request for POC (Nov 21-22)

Hi Amir — thanks for the details and the CSV, that helps.

Short answer: yes, we can provision a short-term sandbox credit uplift for that night. I need to run this past finance for a provisional one-off and confirm exact token allotment.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll capture the expected token/credit estimate and a brief mutual action plan (MAP).
- Loop in Karthik for any perf-engineering knobs (batching/kv-cache) we should enable to reduce token burn.
- Stephanie — can you approve a provisional top-up (one-off) for BrightBridge to cover ~1.2M tokens for a single-night soak? We’ll require a signed short agreement (DocuSign link) and will log the uplift as a promo credit tied to deal BR-45321.

Amir — if that works, I’ll follow up with the exact credit amount and a DocuSign link by EOD Monday (Nov 9).

Thanks,
David
David Kim
